The service unavailability was caused by an incorrect selector (`app: does-not-match`) in the Kubernetes Service `app`, preventing it from discovering the healthy application Pods. I corrected the Service selector to `app: app`.

Verification confirmed that the Service now successfully routes traffic to the application Pods, as evidenced by the presence of three endpoints listed under the Service `app`. Service availability has been restored.
